title: Molecular Basis of TcdR-Dependent Promoter Activity for Toxin Production by Clostridioides difficile Studied by a Heterologous Reporter System.
authors: Zhang, Xinyue; Li, Jie; Chen, Chao; Liu, Ya-Jun; Cui, Qiu; Hong, Wei; Chen, Zhenghong; Feng, Yingang; Cui, Guzhen
one_liner_zh: 该文通过异源报告系统研究艰难梭菌sigma因子TcdR对毒素启动子的识别机制，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但以实验突变分析为主，仅用AlphaFold2结构预测辅助，缺乏AI/物理模拟方法深度，与TF-DNA建模课题关联有限。
abstract: The alternative sigma factor TcdR controls the synthesis of two major enterotoxins: TcdA and TcdB in Clostridioides difficile. Four potential TcdR-dependent promoters in the pathogenicity locus of C. difficile showed different activities. In this study, we constructed a heterologous system in Bacillus subtilis to investigate the molecular basis of TcdR-dependent promoter activity. The promoters of the two major enterotoxins showed strong TcdR-dependent activity, while the two putative TcdR-dependent promoters in the upstream region of the tcdR gene did not show detectable activity, suggesting that the autoregulation of TcdR may need other unknown factors involved. Mutation analysis indicated that the divergent -10 region is the key determinant for different activities of the TcdR-dependent promoters. Analysis of the TcdR model predicted by AlphaFold2 suggested that TcdR should be classified into group 4, i.e., extracytoplasmic function, sigma(70) factors. The results of this study provide the molecular basis of the TcdR-dependent promoter recognition for toxin production. This study also suggests the feasibility of the heterologous system in analyzing sigma factor functions and possibly in drug development targeting these factors.
abstract_zh: 替代sigma因子TcdR控制着艰难梭菌（Clostridioides difficile）中两种主要肠毒素TcdA和TcdB的合成。在艰难梭菌的致病性位点中，四个潜在的TcdR依赖性启动子表现出不同的活性。在本研究中，我们构建了一个枯草芽孢杆菌（Bacillus subtilis）中的异源系统，以探究TcdR依赖性启动子活性的分子基础。两种主要肠毒素的启动子表现出强烈的TcdR依赖性活性，而tcdR基因上游区域的两个推定TcdR依赖性启动子未显示出可检测的活性，这表明TcdR的自调控可能需要其他未知因子的参与。突变分析表明，发散的-10区域是TcdR依赖性启动子不同活性的关键决定因素。对AlphaFold2预测的TcdR模型的分析提示，TcdR应归类于第4组，即胞外功能sigma(70)因子。本研究结果为毒素产生中TcdR依赖性启动子识别提供了分子基础。本研究还表明，异源系统在分析sigma因子功能以及可能针对这些因子的药物开发中具有可行性。
